rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with placeholders (%s, ?) and pass parameters as tuple/dict

rules.message: SQL injection: f-string formatting in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with placeholders (%s, ?) instead of f-strings

rules.message: SQL injection: .format() in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with placeholders (%s, ?) and pass parameters separately

rules.message: SQL injection: % formatting in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries - pass parameters as second argument to execute()

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements with ? placeholders

rules.message: SQL injection: template literal in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with ? placeholders instead of template literals

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use PreparedStatement with parameter placeholders (?)

rules.message: SQL injection: dynamic SQL without parameters
rules.recommendation: Use ? placeholders in PreparedStatement and set parameters with setString/setInt methods

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use prepared statements with PDO or mysqli::prepare() with ? placeholders

rules.message: SQL injection: variable interpolation in double quotes
rules.recommendation: Use prepared statements instead of embedding variables in SQL strings

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with ? placeholders

rules.message: SQL injection: fmt.Sprintf in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with ? placeholders instead of fmt.Sprintf

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with ? placeholders or ActiveRecord query methods

rules.message: SQL injection: string interpolation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with ? placeholders or ActiveRecord query methods

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use SqlParameter with parameterized queries

rules.message: SQL injection: string interpolation in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Use SqlParameter with parameterized queries

rules.message: SQL injection: raw query with string concatenation in ORM
rules.recommendation: Use ORM query builder methods or parameterized raw queries

rules.message: SQL injection: string concatenation in ORM where clause
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized where clauses or query builder methods

rules.message: Potential SQL injection in ORDER BY clause
rules.recommendation: Validate ORDER BY column names against whitelist; use parameterized queries with allowlist

rules.message: Potential SQL injection in LIMIT/OFFSET clause
rules.recommendation: Cast LIMIT/OFFSET values to integers; use parameterized queries

rules.message: Potential second-order SQL injection - stored data used in query
rules.recommendation: Always use parameterized queries even for data from database; assume stored data may be malicious

rules.message: mysql_real_escape_string usage - insufficient protection
rules.recommendation: Use prepared statements instead of manual escaping; escaping can be bypassed

rules.message: addslashes usage for SQL escaping - insufficient protection
rules.recommendation: Use prepared statements; addslashes does not protect against all SQL injection vectors

rules.message: SQL query constructed with user input
rules.recommendation: Always use parameterized queries; never concatenate user input into SQL strings

rules.message: Raw database connection with dynamic SQL
rules.recommendation: Use parameterized queries with prepared statements

rules.message: Dynamic table name in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Validate table names against whitelist; table names cannot be parameterized

rules.message: Dynamic column name in SQL query
rules.recommendation: Validate column names against whitelist; column names cannot be parameterized

rules.message: Potential SQL injection in LIKE clause
rules.recommendation: Escape wildcards (%) and underscore (_); use parameterized queries
